A '''master charge disk''' was a means of payment accepted at [[Acme Droid Service]]. The [[Unidentified Acme Droid Service salesman|salesman]] at Acme Droid Service forbid [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] from leaving the store until they provided their master charge disks for the items they took.<ref name="Droids" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master charge disks were mentioned in the [[Droids (1986) 7|seventh]] issue of the [[1986]] [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|''Star Wars: Droids'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series. The issue was written by [[David Manak]] and [[George Carragone]] and was published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="Droids" /> on [[January 13]], [[1987]].<ref name="Marvel Age">''[[Marvel Age]]'' 48</ref>
